card_name: Air India SBI Platinum Credit Card
fee_details:
- 1st year Fee: Rs. 0
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs. 1,499
reward_structure:
- Transfers: Get 100 = 15 points
- Travel via Air India: 100 = 15 points
- All other categories: 100 = 5 points
key_highlights:
- As its name suggests, the Air India SBI Platinum Card has been designed to deliver premium benefits to frequent air travellers.
- Travel bookings made on Air India are eligible for accelerated reward points.

benefits_features.Travel benefits:
The card offers you a complimentary membership to the Air India Frequent Flyer Program - Flying Returns.
For every Rs. 100 that you spend on booking air tickets on the Air India website, you can earn up to 15 reward points.
It also offers complimentary access to business and domestic airports
benefits_features.Welcome rewards: You can get a welcome gift of 25,000 reward points while signing up for the card. The reward points will be credited within 15 days of joining/first annual fee payment.You also get free membership to the Air India Frequent Flyer Program - Flying Returns as a joining benefit
benefits_features.Milestone Reward points: For annual spends of Rs.2 Lakh you can achieve 5,000 reward points; annual spends above Rs.2 Lakh you earn 10,000 reward points. Thus, the cumulative bonus reward points earned is 15,000
benefits_features.Renewal benefit:
- Earn upto 2,000 reward points every year when you pay the renewal fee for the card.
- Earn 2 reward points/on every Rs. 100 spent on the card.
benefits_features.Reward points program:
- Every Rs. 100 spent on Air India ticket booking will give you 15 reward points (5 reward points for others).
- Reward points can be converted into Air India Miles which can be further redeemed for travel bookings made on the Air India website. 1 Air India Mile = 1.66 Air India Mile
benefits_features.Fuel surcharge waiver: You can avail fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions conducted using the card. The waiver is valid at all petrol pumps across India for transactions worth Rs. 500 or above.The maximum waiver that can be availed per filling is up to Rs.250.
benefits_features.Complimentary lounge access: With the Visa Luxury Access program, you enjoy complimentary visits to select domestic airport lounges. You can also enjoy access to lounges at over 600 international airports with the complimentary Priority Pass Program
benefits_features.Balance transfer on EMI: You can transfer the outstanding balance (on your other credit card) to the SBI card and pay it back in EMI. The balance transfer on SBI card effectively carries a lesser interest rate and processing fee.
benefits_features.Repay: The facility enables you to convert big-ticket purchases made on the card into easy monthly installments. Any purchase worth Rs. 2,500 or above can be converted into EMIs and can be carried back from 3 months to 12 months.
benefits_features.Lost Card Liability Cover: You also enjoy lost card liability coverage of Rs.1 Lakh with the Air India SBI Platinum Card
benefits_features.Railway tickets bookings: With the Air India SBI Platinum Card, you get the facility of booking railway tickets online and getting them delivered at your doorstep.

how_tos.How to Apply for Air India SBI Platinum:
You can apply for the Air India SBI Platinum Card online on the SBI card website.Also another option to apply for the Air India SBI Platinum card through BankBazaar website. This can be done through the following steps:
On the Air India SBI Platinum Card page on BankBazaar.com, check eligibility and complete the form.
Next, you have to enter the required detail followed by uploading of the documents. Click ‘Submit’ when this is done.
To check the status of your Air India SBI Platinum Card, click ‘Track Your Application’ and the application ID will be shown to you.

reward_point_benefits: - You can earn upto 25,000 bonus points via milestone/domestic annual spends.

- 2.5% of the transaction amount or Rs.500 per transaction (RBI and domestic ATMs).
- 2% of the transaction amount or Rs.500 per transaction (International ATMs)

fees_and_charges.Cheque payment fee: Rs.2,000/For cheque payments up to Rs.20,000)
fees_and_charges.Over limit charge: 2.5% of the amount subject to a minimum of Rs.500

miscellaneous:
Eligibility to Apply for Air India SBI Platinum Card
To be eligible for the Air India SBI Platinum Card:
You need to maintain a stable income source. You would be informed about the income criteria when you apply for the card.
You must not have a high credit-to-debt ratio.
There are other eligibility criteria; you would be informed about the same.

faqs.When I apply for Air India SBI Platinum: Yes, you may use the ‘save & quit’ option.
faqs.How can I retrieve my Air India SBI Plat: To retrieve your saved Air India SBI Platinum Card saved application, you can simply log into the application page and click the retrieve option.
faqs.How do I redeem my reward points on the: For converting your reward points to the miles for Air India redemption, Air India Miles Call at SBI Card: 1800 120 1290, 1800 180 1290 or 39000202. You require a minimum of 2,000 reward points for availing the redemption option. Air India Mile redemption has to be in multiples of 500 and will be converted within 1 week from the date of the request.
